issues.description: `remove_rel_children` recursively duplicates information already available through `recursive_trace`, adding an unnecessary parallel specification helper.
issues.rationale: The helper walks the same path solely to recover the removal-point relation, while the existing recursive trace already identifies that node. The maintainer explicitly requested expressing the condition through `recursive_trace`; the immediate next commit removes the helper and rewrites the precondition accordingly, after which the PR is approved.
